tools.name: product_lookup
tools.description: Look up one product by its barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A, check digit validated). Returns factual data from ProductGuru: name, brand/maker, manufacturer website (when known), category, recorded attributes, and official recall notices (agency, date, notice link), plus the URL of the ProductGuru product page. Answers 'not found' when ProductGuru has no published product page for the barcode. One barcode per call; no search or listing.

ean.description: One barcode: EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A digits (string or number).
ean.title: Ean

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ProductGuru's published products and official recall notices. Pass a barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A) to get that product and any recall notice linked to it, or words (e.g. 'power bank') to search product names. Returns at most 10 results, each with an id, title and URL; pass an id to fetch for the full factual record. Ids are 'p:<ean>' (product) or 'r:<recall>' (recall notice). Medicines are not covered.

query.description: A barcode (8, 12 or 13 digits) or a few words naming a product.
query.title: Query

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one ProductGuru record by the id that search returned: 'p:<ean>' for a product (name, brand/maker, category, recorded attributes, linked recall notices) or 'r:<recall>' for an official recall notice (issuing agency, date, summary, link to the authority's notice). Returns id, title, text, url and metadata. Factual data only.
